items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: they had Darcy with me on the beach up there

ctx.x: That's why these men, you see they come over like this. Cover it over, huh? No, they don't cover it over. It's like this. About this wide. See about three inches wide. You understand what I mean? They got gas lights in them. Oh, yeah. Oh, man, that thing be so warm. The same Billy can tell you. All that boy Charlie Hammond tell you, they had Darcy with me on the beach up there. Oh, yeah. And, man, they were so hot in that yard, and they was freezing outside. They were really freezing out there.
That's the first time I've ever seen anything like that. First time I've ever seen anything like that.
